latin: Duplex genus demonum de quibus dixit secundum Porphirium praecedens conclusio nihil credimus esse aliud quam membrorum legem et potestates harum tenebrarum, de quibus apud Paulum, quamuis de quiditate et substantia harum potestatum eos non credo conuenire.
translation: The two kinds of demons that the preceding conclusion, following Porphyry, spoke of are, we believe, nothing other than the law of the members and the powers of this darkness mentioned in Paul; though as to the quiddity and substance of these powers, I do not believe that they agree.
